items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: And he was, at that time he was working with Frank Sinatra when Sinatra was going out of town

ctx.x: So if you were to watch that on TV you’d be listening to yourself?

Yeah, yeah, yeah. And Vince, he was a character. And he was a good musician and I got to do that for a while, and associating with somebody like that it puts your name out there. So that was probably the first. And then I got in with a guy, the guy that’s doing all the work here, a real good drummer named John Markham, he’s deceased now, and he was like a big band drummer but he could do everything. And he was, at that time he was working with Frank Sinatra when Sinatra was going out of town, and so he heard me…
What would a typical club date have paid in the mid 60s and late 60s in this area?
